import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    it = iter(sys.stdin.buffer)
    next(it)
    for line in it:
        p = line.split(b',')
        d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    for k in sorted(d):
        print("%s %.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]))
main()

import sys
def main():
    d = {}
    f = sys.stdin.buffer
    f.readline()
    g = d.get
    for line in f:
        i = line.index(b',')
        j = line.index(b',', i+1)
        c = line[i+1:j]
        d[c] = g(c, 0.0) + float(line[j+1:])
    for k in sorted(d):
        print("%s %.2f" % (k.decode(), d[k]))
main()
